newsitem.title: USA: NU sees Seabrook nuke at full output Thurs.
newsitem.headline: NU sees Seabrook nuke at full output Thurs.

text.p: Northeast Utilities expected the 1,164 megawatt (MW) nuclear generation plant in Seabrook, N.H., to reach full output later Thursday after briefly trimming production overnight, a company spokesman said.
The company changed the backup power unit for one of the station's two feedwater pumps. Seabrook's output was lowered to 65 percent of capacity while the swap was taking place.
"The work is completed. We're coming up at five percent power an hour," said spokesman David Barr, adding Seabrook was running in the 800-900 MW range or 68-77 percent of capacity Thursday morning.
Northeast Utilities, the operator of Seabrook, has a 39.6 percent interest in the station. The remaining interests are split among several New England utilities.
